intent: Write a skill that helps run multi-container apps with Docker Compose

snippets.text: Docker Compose runs multi-container applications defined in a compose.yaml file. Use `docker compose up -d` to start all services in the background and `docker compose down` to stop and remove them.

intent: Create a skill for writing pytest fixtures and parametrized tests

snippets.text: Fixtures are defined with the @pytest.fixture decorator and requested by naming them as test function arguments. Use @pytest.mark.parametrize to run one test with several argument sets.

intent: A skill for reviewing code against the OWASP guidance on SQL injection

snippets.text: The primary defence against SQL injection is the use of prepared statements with parameterized queries. Never build queries by concatenating user input. Use allow-list input validation as a secondary defence.

intent: Напиши навичку для розгортання застосунку в Kubernetes через Deployment

snippets.text: A Deployment manages a set of identical Pods. Apply a manifest with `kubectl apply -f deployment.yaml` and check the rollout with `kubectl rollout status deployment/<name>`.

intent: Потрібна навичка для проєктування REST API: ресурси та коди відповідей

snippets.text: Use plural nouns for resources, for example /orders. Return 201 Created with a Location header after a successful POST and 404 Not Found when the resource does not exist.

intent: Навичка для тестування FastAPI сервісу за допомогою pytest

snippets.text: Use TestClient from fastapi.testclient to call the application without running a server: client = TestClient(app).
Share setup between tests with fixtures declared by @pytest.fixture.

intent: Skill for deploying Docker images to Kubernetes

snippets.text: Build an image with `docker build -t name:tag .` and publish it with `docker push name:tag`.
Reference the pushed image in the container spec of a Deployment, then roll out with `kubectl apply -f`.

intent: Turn my team's release checklist into a skill
source_text: Release checklist: 1) freeze main, 2) run the smoke suite, 3) tag the commit as vX.Y.Z, 4) announce in #releases.
